# Top Hat

> Top Hat is an AI-powered interactive learning platform enabling educators to create engaging classrooms through live polling, assessments, analytics, and intelligent content tools.

Top Hat serves 750+ campuses and 1,500+ institutions with comprehensive solutions for student engagement, learning analytics, and course content delivery. The platform integrates with major LMS systems like Canvas, Blackboard, D2L, and Moodle, and features Ace, an AI assistant for personalized learning support.

- [Top Hat | Interactive Learning Platform](https://tophat.com): Top Hat homepage: AI-powered interactive learning platform with polls, quizzes, discussions
- [A Teaching Platform With Live Polling, eTexts + More | Top Hat](https://tophat.com/features): Top Hat features overview: live polling, interactive textbooks, attendance tracking
- [What's New: Interactive Learning Tools | Top Hat](https://tophat.com/features/whats-new): New features in Top Hat: AI-powered assistance, Ace, video integration, accessibility
- [A Tool That Combines Discussions & Polling Software | Top Hat](https://tophat.com/features/inclass-engagement): Top Hat in-class engagement: polling, discussions, live quizzes, real-time feedback
- [Dynamic College Textbooks for Student Engagement | Top Hat](https://tophat.com/features/interactive-content): Top Hat interactive eTexts: personalized digital textbooks with OpenStax content
- [Class Attendance & Attendance Tracking Software | Top Hat](https://tophat.com/features/attendance): Top Hat attendance tracking: automated roll calls, LMS integration, geolocation

## AI & Assessment Tools

- [Top Hat Ace | Top Hat](https://tophat.com/features/ace-ai): Top Hat Ace: AI-powered assistant for study support, assessment generation, engagement
- [Accessible, Interactive Course Content Made Easier | Top Hat](https://tophat.com/features/content-enhancer): Ace Content Enhancer: AI transforms PDFs into accessible interactive course content
- [Dynamic Tools For Exams & Homework Assignments | Top Hat](https://tophat.com/features/assessments-and-preparedness): Top Hat assessments: homework, exams, interactive polls, AI assistant for assignments
- [Learning Insights & Analytics Software | Top Hat](https://tophat.com/features/insights): Top Hat learning analytics: real-time insights on assignments, attendance, participation
